description.value: Nesters Market is a Western Canadian neighbourhood grocery chain founded in Whistler in 1987 and now operating 16+ locations across BC and Alberta. The Main Street Vancouver location offers a full range of fresh produce, deli and bistro, in-store bakery, pharmacy, and a strong selection of local, organic, and specialty products. Operated by the Pattison Food Group, it positions itself as a quality-focused community grocer and would serve touring cyclists well for resupply.
